figurative_meaning_en: Something that does not let go easily
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাদের প্রেম কাঁঠালের আঠার মতো অটুট।
এই অভ্যাস কাঁঠালের আঠার মতো ছাড়তে কঠিন।
example_sentences_in_english: Their love is as inseparable as jackfruit glue.
This habit is hard to break, like jackfruit glue.
note: Refers to the sticky latex from jackfruit, symbolizing strong adhesion in Bengali folklore.
